summary: BitVentures Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing unaudited financial results for H1 FY2026, along with a business update. The update details a share capital restructuring completed in December 2025, which included termination of its ADS program, a 20-to-1 share consolidation, and substitution listing of ordinary shares on Nasdaq. The filing also describes routine operational developments in e-commerce and digital assets segments. No special-situation transaction—such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or activist campaign—is disclosed. This is a standard earnings and business update filing for a foreign private issuer.
